description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication-related endpoints, including health check, signup, login, and password reset, with integration to user and tenant models, JWT token issuance, and password hashing/migration logic.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Health check endpoint for auth configuration status.

methods.name: router.post('/signup')
methods.description: Endpoint to create or update a user with hashed password, generating tenant salt if needed.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticate user, perform password verification and migration, issue JWT token.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Reset user password, rehashing with v2 scheme, generating tenant salt if missing.
